Freeze tooling, docs and org scope definitions and baselines. Report protected, historical and generated material separately; do not create a reduction incentive to rewrite them.

Independent sceptics challenge each dimension; a final completeness critic checks every ledger row. No feature is removed and no protected, derived, append-only or historical task file is hand-edited.
